test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that CANNOT be concluded from the statements given below.

**Statement 1:** All snakes are pizza.

**Statement 2:** Some pizzas are tea.

**Statement 3:** Some snakes are tea.

options.text: Some tea are not snake but they are pizza.
All pizzas are either tea or snake.
Some tea are both pizza and snake.
Some pizzas are neither tea nor snake.

solution:
The possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa57ad1c67a68b588547098640624f743b295264ddb54410abd48e33a5ac606d.png] 

Conclusions:

Option 1) Some tea are not snake but they are pizza → Follow (As some snakes are tea and some pizzas are tea. As whole snakes comes in pizzas and have some part common with tea, therefore it is true.)

Option 2) All pizzas are either tea or snake → Does not follow (As all snakes are pizza and some pizzas are tea. As whole snakes comes in pizzas and have some part common with tea, therefore pizzas has some part common with both snakes and tea simultaneously thus it is false.)

Option 3) Some tea are both pizza and snake → Follow (As some pizzas are tea and some snakes are tea. As both snakes and pizzas have some part common with tea, therefore it is true.)

Option 4) Some pizzas are neither tea nor snake → Follow (As all snakes are pizza and some pizzas are tea. As whole snakes comes in pizzas and have some part common with tea, therefore pizzas has some part common with both snakes and tea simultaneously thus it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion "All pizzas are either tea or snake" does not follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
